title: Consolidate approved external-repository specifications, dependency DAG and role rules against the accepted engine
acceptance: Why: The captain approved the external-repository roadmap, replacing stale rules and specs, using /Users/benjamin/Desktop/maker-founder as a fresh repository. Existing repairs must finish first. This task consolidates approved specifications, dependency DAG, design and role rules before external runtime implementation; it does not implement those features or waive any acceptance. Commit its own task spec.

Align task specs and design with approved dependency revisions and all feature requirements in the supplied planning references. Require this consolidation task as the dependency of the first external storage task; preserve sequential prerequisites and permit parallel independent evidence/brief work with shared-file coordination. Do not introduce a cycle. Retire T072/T094/T095/T097 and overlapping T075/T076 with explicit replacement/deferred tracing; keep T030 parked and do not claim solved.

Use FM_HOME/projects/<name>/{repo,worktrees,CONVENTIONS.md,tasks,design.md,state} for external project data, including private repos. Engine state must not contain their private specs/worktrees/evidence. Self project compatibility, migration approval and path validation remain explicit. Handle unreadable protection as unknown requiring confirmed project checks, not automatic rejection or implicit permission.

External workers/reviewers/gates/cleanup accept project context consistently; exact project+task identity separates same task IDs. Bind accepted private local spec snapshots and hashes, isolated checked-out head, reviewer identity, final answer provenance, current required check-runs plus commit statuses, and local evidence with configurable GitHub projection. Respect project merge/review/post conventions and stacking; no hardcoded squash/delete assumptions. No protected-base force push. Task branch leases only under confirmed project policy.

Use six gates numbered1,2,4,5,6,7; gate3 retired. CI pending is distinct from failure, context packs bounded visibly, current reviewer verdict protocol authentic and closed-list preserved. Global concurrency uses live owned runs and identity locks rather than historical open PR counts. Zero-model scripted push-based supervision and lifelines, no old setsid/beacon requirements. Visible Herdr dispatch and cmuxOnly remain; detached full cmux lifecycle stays explicitly deferred.

Rewrite T055 to require actual maker-founder empty-repo onboarding, task creation/approval, external Codex worker dispatch in a visible owned Herdr window, private immutable spec, isolated reviewer, checks/gates, captured outputs and cleanup/retention verification. Bootstrap no-commit/no-remote must be represented explicitly: user authorized this new repo, but infer no product brief or remote visibility. At most three questions only for genuinely missing project contract choices. Basic pilot does not depend on full advanced autopilot/external-bot stack; advanced T140/T143/T141 remain part of the roadmap and are not declared complete or silently dropped.

Refresh firstmate/worker/reviewer role rules to match accepted current T163 Codex run-mode, eventual T164 hook trust/delivery contract, current T130 feature test organization and approved captain merge authority; preserve role separation, current-head evidence, project conventions and traceable captain intent. No production scripts/tests changed by this consolidation task. Document all adopted/deferred rules so reviewers can assess the final intended feature set.

Core external first-dispatch must launch a genuinely live owned run through the standard stock dispatcher and retain its user-visible Herdr view; a manual firstmate relaunch after a dead dispatch does not establish this capability. T051 scope must cover its required dispatcher/lifeline integration, without waiting for full advanced T141 autopilot. Depend on accepted T167 availability classification for truthful worker outcome and completion ownership.

Current-head acceptance must first synchronize and verify the authoritative GitHub PR head against the local task ref and isolated checkout. Required CI, gates, reviewed head/patch and merge candidate must be co-bound to that verified head; a green gate over a stale local branch cannot establish remote-head readiness. Refresh T051/T052/T138 scopes and specs for this boundary, with regression evidence for GitHub update-branch changing the remote while local refs remain stale. Preserve approval carry-forward only when the authoritative current patch-id is unchanged.
